stories.title: No Blanks, No Blemishes
stories.detail: 2 points or better on every hole through 8 - not a blemish yet

stories.title: In the Hunt
stories.detail: 2nd - 5 off the pace with 4 to play

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Cheers to Kenneth Pepper from Geraldton GC for making the drive, come back and do it again soon.

stories.title: Big-Dog Territory
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 5s - bombing them and cashing in

stories.title: Short-Hole Sniper
stories.detail: 2 threes on the par 3s - dialled in with the irons

stories.title: Brief Interruption
stories.detail: Back-to-back wipes on holes 17 & 18 - we'll pretend this didn't happen

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 3 twos in a row on holes 14, 15 & 16 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: Rough Patch
stories.detail: 2 wipes on holes 17 & 18 - club still in the bag

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 11, 12 & 13 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: The Golf Tax Strikes Again
stories.detail: 3-pointer to 1-pointer on holes 14 & 15 - the course always takes its cut
